programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Blakey, Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard & Curtis Fuller
programme.sub-title: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right. The group performed Cedar Walton's arrangement of That Old Feeling (written by Sammy Fain), Wayne Shorter's arrangement of I Didn't Know What Time It Was (written by Richard Rodgers), and Caravan (written by Juan Tizol and Duke Ellington).

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Ron Carter & Jul Barretto
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here. With bassist Ron Carter - one of the living legends on this instrument - and highly talented Cuban jazz drummer Julio Barreto, Rubalcaba's trio marks an important step in the development of jazz trio playing in the 1990s. Moreover, it demonstrates the brilliant improvisational and technical abilities of Gonzalo Rubalcaba, who has become one of our present-day jazz legends.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seasick Steve
programme.desc: Steven Gene Wold, commonly known as Seasick Steve, (born circa 1941) is an American bluesman, although he prefers to be called "a song and dance man". He plays guitars (mostly personalized), and sings, usually about his early life living rough and doing casual work.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Sergey Malov

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Slipknot
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Murder
programme.desc: Diana learns she inherited an old house from her aunt, who may have been murdered.

programme.title: Jim Henson's Turkey Hollow
programme.desc: Lifetime Original Movie traces the Emmerson family's journey to Turkey Hollow.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it's too late.

programme.title: WWJD What Would Jesus Do?
programme.desc: A group of Americans - a singer, a newspaper editor, a pastor and a real estate mogul - vow to walk in the steps of Jesus. Every day, every decision becomes a turning point in their lives as they must ask themselves "What Would Jesus Do?"

programme.title: Baby Bootcamp
programme.desc: Fitness instructor Julia is down on her luck, trying to make her baby boot camp a thriving business. To make ends meet, she becomes a part-time nanny for a single widowed father. Trouble is, she knows nothing about taking care of children.

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.title: Love's Sweet Recipe
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a talented chef and her childhood best friend as she regains her passion for cooking.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Nicole Kidman and wickedly funny Will Ferrell star as actors playing Darrin and Samantha on a remake of the television show "Bewitched" in this cleverly crafty comedy from director NoraEphron.

programme.title: Excess Baggage
programme.desc: Alicia Silverstone (Clueless) stars in this romantic comedy about a woman who tries to get back at her father by faking her own kidnapping. When her harebrained scheme gets her locked in the trunk of her own car, she falls into a relationship with a car thief (Benicio Del Toro).

programme.title: Oily To Bed, Oily To Rise
programme.desc: The Stooges are tramps looking for handouts. Although the boys are down and out, Curly seems to get everything he wishes for. After some trouble with a farmer, the boys come across an abandoned car, one of Curly's wishes. The car actually belongs to some con men who have just gypped the widow Jenkins out of her land. The boys wind up at the Mrs. Jenkins house just in time for a free meal. To repay Mrs. Jenkins the boys try to fix her well and instead unleash an oil geyser. Learning that Mrs. Jenkins has been swindled, the boys go to retrieve the deed before it can be recorded. They find the bad guys and after a wild fight recover the deed. The boys return the deed to Mrs. Jenkins and marry her daughters April, May and June.

programme.title: One Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A series of mishaps threaten a recently divorced mom's attempts to make her two kids' first Christmas "without dad" perfect.

programme.title: Little Women (1994)
programme.desc: Winona Ryder lights up the screen in this classic story of love and family devotion.

programme.title: Ride the Eagle
programme.desc: Leif (Jake Johnson) inherits a picturesque log cabin when his estranged mother Honey (Susan Sarandon) dies. But there is a condition he must first complete her elaborate to-do list.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: An innovative film that incorporates influences from multiple genres to create a hilarious hybrid of film noir, crime drama, and cop buddy picture — with a healthy dose of R-Rated profanity and humor.

programme.title: King of California
programme.desc: An unstable dad who after getting out of a mental institution tries to convince his daughter that there's Spanish gold buried somewhere under suburbia.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner's deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid embarks on a dual mission: rescuing a girl from a marriage to a false suitor and tracking down outlaws who robbed a gold-carrying stage. His task becomes clearer when he discovers that the so-called wealthy suitor is secretly behind the robbery. Cisco must untangle love, deception, and crime to bring justice.

programme.title: White Fang
programme.desc: The wolf dog, White Fang, aids a reporter, a fur trapper, a nun, a young Eskimo boy and his father of ridding a gold mining town of a sleazy crime lord in 1896 Yukon, Canada.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: A ghostlike stranger arrives to avenge a Civil War betrayal. Former Confederate officers who caused the massacre of their own unit begin to die one by one, as Django delivers chilling justice from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: In a mining town, Johnny MaGee clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses bandits and deceit to seize gold mines and control the economy. Partnering with an old miner, Johnny seeks justice, while navigating love, betrayal, and alliances. As tensions rise, a bounty hunter joins the fray, promising a final showdown against corruption.

programme.title: Border Shootout
programme.desc: Young rancher Kirby Frye is appointed deputy in a small town tyrannized by ruthless Phil Sundeen, the son of one of the founders of the town.

programme.title: Rockets Galore
programme.desc: This sequel to 'Whisky Galore!' sees the islanders of Todday at odds with the authorities from the mainland.

programme.title: Flying Scotsman
programme.desc: The day before he is due to retire an old engine-driver reports his stoker for drunkenness. The man is discharged and threatens to make trouble. As the train is leaving on the driver's last run the stoker boards it, followed by the driver's daughter. During the run the old man discovers what he believes to be an illicit love between his daughter and the new stoker, whom he knocks off the cab. He is himself struck down by his former mate, but the girl is also there, and she is faced with the awesome task of bringing the great train safely to a standstill.

programme.title: Family Way

programme.title: The Executioners Mask

programme.title: The Royal Ring

programme.title: Set in Stone

Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Blakey, Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard & Curtis Fuller
programme.sub-title: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right. The group performed Cedar Walton's arrangement of That Old Feeling (written by Sammy Fain), Wayne Shorter's arrangement of I Didn't Know What Time It Was (written by Richard Rodgers), and Caravan (written by Juan Tizol and Duke Ellington).

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Ron Carter & Jul Barretto
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here. With bassist Ron Carter - one of the living legends on this instrument - and highly talented Cuban jazz drummer Julio Barreto, Rubalcaba's trio marks an important step in the development of jazz trio playing in the 1990s. Moreover, it demonstrates the brilliant improvisational and technical abilities of Gonzalo Rubalcaba, who has become one of our present-day jazz legends.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Seasick Steve
programme.desc: Steven Gene Wold, commonly known as Seasick Steve, (born circa 1941) is an American bluesman, although he prefers to be called "a song and dance man". He plays guitars (mostly personalized), and sings, usually about his early life living rough and doing casual work.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Sergey Malov

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Slipknot
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland
programme.desc: Flying Over Iceland: Part I is a stunning yet soothing aerial journey to the remote fjiords and valleys of eastern Iceland. The first of a series of 1 hour films, Part I begins at sunrise on a perfect summer day in Breiðdalsvík, where a golden sun lights up the majestic valley. After soaring through the golden sea mists and offering a glimpse of the stunning Breiðdalur Valley (its name means ‘Wide Valley'), viewers then head inland to a hidden, magical arched waterfall for a refreshing immersive flight that begins at the base of the falls and reaches above the clouds. Next, as the morning turns into a sunlit afternoon, viewers are swept inland to the crystal clear waters of the the impressive Breiðdalsá river, to cool off in some falls along with a pair of local swans. Well known for salmon fishing, the turquoise blue river winds its way scenically across the valley basin to the sea, which is where the film ends - but not before a chance encounter with a local reindeer! The final flight in Part 1 offers a sunny afternoon look at the tiny village of Breiðdalsvík from afar and offers amazing blue water vistas of with green islands, seagulls, a rock island that that looks like a cat, a scenic lighthouse, and more.

programme.title: Yo compré una moto vampiro

Tras ser comprada y reparada, revelará su auténtica naturaleza y buscará vengarse del motero que causó su muerte y de cualquiera que se interponga en su camino.

programme.title: Pussy Riot: una plegaria punk

Su arresto y posterior juicio ha dado la vuelta al mundo y ha transformado la sociedad rusa para siempre. Siguiendo los giros inesperados de este juicio, el documental nos muestra a las verdaderas personas a la vez que somos testigos de su transformación de activistas políticas a iconos de la modernidad.

programme.title: Tiburones del Hielo

Una persona que se encarga de sobornar jurados juega al gato y al ratón con un miembro de jurado y un agente externo misterioso que ofrecen dar un veredicto a favor del mejor postor.

programme.title: Alta Mar
programme.desc: Tres parejas celebran un cumpleaños en un yate para pasar un lujoso fin de semana. Tras la noche todo parece en calma, pero nada más lejos de la realidad. Su pesadilla acaba de empezar.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: Dreamin' Wild (Un sueño Maravilloso)
programme.desc: Cuando el álbum de los hermanos Emerson, olvidado por años, finalmente obtiene reconocimiento, deben enfrentarse a las repercusiones emocionales de la fama tardía y las oportunidades perdidas.

programme.title: La verdadera historia de Hamlet, príncipe de Dinamarca
programme.desc: Una antigua leyenda nórdica sobre la venganza, el poder y el espíritu humano, que posteriormente inspiró a William Shakespeare en su tragedia Hamlet.

programme.title: Un pequeño mundo
programme.desc: Nora entra en primaria cuando descubre el acoso que sufre su hermano mayor, Abel. Nora se debate entre su padre, que la anima a actuar, la necesidad de integrarse y su hermano, que le pide que guarde silencio: un terrible conflicto de lealtad.

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: Adiós, mundo
programme.desc: Película post-apocalíptica americana que cuenta la historia de una pareja que educa a su hija, hasta que un desastre provoca un cambio radical en la vida que llevan y en la forma en que ven a sus amigos.

programme.title: Recuerdos De Navidad
programme.desc: Después de años de vivir bajo la excesiva obsesión navideña de su madre, Noelle abandonó la Navidad.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Un chico cambia de religión para para conquistar a una chica judía.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas de Navidad, tres hermanas deciden viajar para para replantearse su vida amorosa.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo por algunos acontecimientos ocurridos.

programme.title: El fin del sexo (The End of Sex)
programme.desc: Una pareja que siente las presiones de la paternidad y la edad adulta envía a sus hijos a un campamento de invierno por primera vez y se embarca en una serie de aventuras sexuales para revitalizar su relación.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de “Paris, je t'aime” (2006), doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como plató y narran diferentes historias de amor en esta película coral que muestra la pasión que puede despertar esa gran ciudad.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Claude, un hombre viudo de unos setenta años, que vive solo y está desencantado con su única hija, se entera un día de que LILLIAN, la mujer que fue el el primer amor de su vida tiene Alzheimer y está ingresada en una residencia especializada.

programme.title: Emma (de Jane Austen)
programme.desc: Emma Woodhouse (Kate Beckinsale) es una atractiva joven de familia pudiente que ocupa su ocio en emparejar sentimentalmente a cuantos ella desea, aunque no siempre con buenos resultados.

programme.title: La casa al final de la calle
programme.desc: Elissa y su madre se mudan a una pequeña ciudad, al lado de una casa donde una joven asesinó a sus padres. Los habitantes del lugar afirman que la chica desapareció misteriosamente después del incidente. Elissa entabla amistad con el hermano de la presunta asesina y pronto percibe que un oscuro y terrible secreto todavía acecha dentro de esas paredes. Una siniestra historia de asesinatos que está lejos de terminar.

programme.title: El infierno bajo tierra
programme.desc: En el desierto del Sáhara, una tormenta de arena golpea una estación de perforación abandonada. Thomas ""Jack"" Jackman, un patrullero de seguridad, lucha contra los fuertes vientos para averiguar por qué se ha perdido todo contacto con la estación. Originalmente construido para la exploración de gas, y luego abandonado, el sitio había sido recientemente ocupado por un equipo científico de investigación internacional con la misión de realizar la perforación más profunda jamás lograda.

programme.title: Avispas asesinas
programme.desc: Cuando su padre desaparece misteriosamente en una expedición, la hermosa entomóloga Gina Humphries y su asistente, Rhonda, deciden ir a buscarlo en la selva tropical de Belice. Debido a numerosos robos y asaltos, se adentran en la selva escoltadas por un grupo de soldados fuertemente armados. El convoy sufre una emboscada y se inicia un sangriento enfrentamiento. Justo cuando las cosas no pueden ir peor, una horda de avispas Dragón asesinas, insectos voladores gigantes que disparan fuego de su abdomen, ataca al grupo.

programme.title: Despertando a Ned
programme.desc: Tullymore es un pequeño e idílico pueblo irlandés cuya tranquilidad se rompe cuando a uno de sus 52 habitantes le toca el primer premio de la lotería. Se trata de Ned, un anciano sin familia que es encontrado muerto ese mismo día con el billete premiado entre las manos y una sonrisa de felicidad en el rostro. Jackie y su mejor amigo Michael deciden hacerse pasar por Ned para reclamar el premio.

programme.title: El fotógrafo de Minamata
programme.desc: Nueva York, 1971. Tras sus celebrados días como uno de los fotoperiodistas más venerados de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, W. Eugene Smith se siente desconectado de la sociedad y de su carrera.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: El Partido Repartido
programme.desc: Bryan, un ambicioso joven político, conoce a Serena, una poderosa mujer dentro del partido político.

programme.title: Súper Papá
programme.desc: Un padre viudo con seis hijos, sostiene una batalla legal con sus suegros por la custodia de los niños.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Cuando Minnesota West salva al joven Silver, el chico lo lleva a Holysand, una ciudad al borde del caos.

programme.title: Juntos Para Vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado fantasea con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Boda en top end
programme.desc: Lauren y Ned están prometidos y tienen 10 días para encontrar a la madre de Lauren, que ha desaparecido, reunir a sus padres, y tener la boda de sus sueños.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: Peg Dahl (Zoey Deutch) es una joven que sueña con ir a la Universidad para luego ganar dinero y dejar atrás su vida en una de las zonas más pobres de su ciudad.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: La comedia persigue a cuatro huérfanos que visitan una fábrica de chocolates y son transportados al increíble mundo de Gnarnia, luego de toparse con un armario encantado. Allí, luchan contra piratas, conocen a magos sabios e intentan derrotar a la Bruja Blanca de Gnarnia.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Padres adoptivos
programme.desc: Coline y André se llevan a las mil maravillas con su hija, Garance, y con su yerno, Harold. Pero Garance decide romper con Harold y ordena a sus padres que nunca más lo vean.

programme.title: Ricki
programme.desc: Ricki es la líder de un grupo de música que se dedica a interpretar versiones de canciones de otros artistas, que buscando perseguir su sueño de ser una estrella de rock decidió abandonar a sus tres hijos y a su marido. Pero años después de dejar atrás a su familia tendrá que enfrentarse a la realidad cuando regrese para ayudar a su hija que está pasando por una mala situación.

programme.title: Dick y Jane Ladrones de Risa
programme.desc: Nada más ascender, el ambicioso Dick se ve obligado a comparecer ante las cámaras de televisión para explicar por qué el presidente de su empresa Globodyne se ha desecho repentinamente de sus acciones. Dick se ve envuelto en una especie de escándalo corporativo: en un instante pierde todo lo que pensaba que tenía.

programme.title: Vaya Navidades
programme.desc: Este año parece que los Whitfield tendrán una Navidad inolvidable. Por primera vez en años, todos los hermanos vinieron a casa, trajeron mucho equipaje. Mientras adornan el árbol de Navidad y cuelgan las luces, se revelan los secretos y el vínculo de la familia es puesto a prueba. Cuando sus vidas convergen, se juntan todos y se ayudan el uno al otro a descubrir el sentido verdadero de la familia.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Suzy acaba de volver del hospital y necesita cuidados las 24 horas del día. Su marido, Duncan, decide que la mejor medicina para Suzy podría ser un regalo de Navidad que nunca olvidará: subirse a una noria instalada en su propio jardín. ¿Por qué una noria? Porque fue en una noria cuando hace muchas lunas Duncan pidió a Suzy que se casara con él.

programme.title: La tribu de los pawnee
programme.desc: Pale Arrow es un hombre blanco criado desde niño por el Jefe Pawnee. Con las caravanas que invaden la tierra de los Pawnee, el Jefe envía a Flecha Pálida a estar con los blancos.

programme.title: Las campanas de San Angelo
programme.desc: Gridley contrabandea plata desde México usando un pasaje secreto. El guardia Roy Rogers lo descubre y envía a Lee Madison por ayuda, pero ella es capturada. Con refuerzos y la ayuda de Trigger, Roy intenta rescatarla y frenar el plan de Gridley.

programme.title: Tulsa, ciudad de lucha
programme.desc: En Tulsa, tras la muerte de un ranchero en una disputa con una gran compañía petrolera, su hija, movida por la venganza, empieza a buscar petróleo.

programme.title: Perseguido
programme.desc: Huérfano tras el asesinato de su familia, Jeb es criado en un rancho, pero su pasado lo persigue. Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, juicio de fuego
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduce a los colonos a Kentucky, pero debe luchar contra los indios Shawnee que han sido convencidos por un renegado francés de que Boone y los colonos están allí para matarlos y robarles sus tierras.

programme.title: Dark Island
programme.desc: El terror aguarda a un equipo de soldados y científicos que han llegado a una instalación de armas biológicas para determinar por qué se perdió el contacto con los investigadores del lugar.

programme.title: Engañadas
programme.desc: El alcalde de Detroit pone fin a sus negocios con la mafia rusa cuando unas jóvenes son secuestradas y aparecen drogadas y muertas. Los mejores detectives (2 mujeres) son asignados al caso. Los rusos secuestran también a la hija adulta del alcalde como garantía.

programme.title: La muerte juega a los dados
programme.desc: Cuatro compañeros de trabajo van a hacer una barbacoa en una isla. Después de emborracharse, uno de ellos muere accidentalmente en un juego. Mientras intentaba deshacerse del cuerpo, el ayudante de su trabajo llega inesperadamente a la isla.

programme.title: Executor
programme.desc: Un despiadado asesino, entrenado para matar en nombre de Dios por un sacerdote corrupto, reevalúa el propósito de su vida después de salvar a un niño pequeño de uno de sus propios intentos de asesinato.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Arthur 3: La guerra de los mundos
programme.desc: “Tercera y última entrega de la trilogía de Arthur y los Minimoys. Maltazard ha conseguido colarse en el mundo de los humanos. Su objetivo es sencillo: reclutar un ejército de gigantescos secuaces y dominar el universo. Arthur parece ser el único capaz de frustrar sus planes, pero primero tendrá que volver a su habitación... y recuperar su tamaño normal.” Aunque sigue atrapado en un diminuto cuerpo de minimoy, contará con la ayuda de Selenia y Betameche, y, sorprendentemente, también la de Darkos, el hijo de Maltazard, que afirma estar de su lado. A pie, en bici, en coche o incluso en una Harley Davidson, Arthur y sus amigos emplearán cualquier medio a su alcance para librar su batalla final contra Maltazard.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Barcelona (Un mapa)
programme.desc: Seis personajes, arquetipos contemporáneos de la soledad urbana, se encuentran en un viejo piso del Ensanche barcelonés.

programme.title: El desentierro
programme.desc: La repentina aparición de la joven Vera en un pueblo del levante costero provoca que Jordi decida emprender la búsqueda de su padre, al cual había dado por muerto durante 20 años.

programme.title: Capitán Kóblic
programme.desc: Año 1977. El Capitán Tomás Kóblic (Ricardo Darín), comandante de la Armada Argentina, se enfrenta a la misión más complicada de su vida: pilotar un "vuelo de la muerte".

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Chocolate Strawberry Vanilla
programme.desc: Awkward, lonely ice-cream truck driver Warren Thompson has two major problems: an unhealthy obsession with a soap opera actress, and a gang of bullies who like to savagely beat him on a regular basis. As Warren slowly slips out of reality and into a psychotic fantasy world to escape his miserable life, a darker, deadlier Warren emerges to deal with his problems and put an end to his tormentors.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: Spider Baby
programme.desc: An inbred family is visited in their rural mansion by greedy distant relatives intent on taking the family home and inheritance.

programme.title: Cuadecuc Vampir
programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: Dead Man's Cards
programme.desc: Ex-boxer Tom is on the ropes. His career is over, his marriage is on the rocks and he's broke. When a chance encounter leads to the offer of work, the jury is out on whether he is on the road to redemption or if he will hit the self-destruct button.

programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Catástrofe en la Tierra
programme.desc: Después de un destello en el cielo, la Luna desaparece. Tras un segundo destello, nadie recuerda nada. Once meses después la Tierra se ha convertido en un lugar postapocalíptico, ya que fue absorbida por un agujero de gusano. Rodeados de catástrofes naturales constantes y sin forma alguna de civilización, los supervivientes deberán encontrar un lugar seguro donde volver a empezar.

programme.title: Dragones de Camelot
programme.desc: El reino de Camelot se ve sumido en la oscuridad después de la muerte del noble rey Arturo, cuando comienza el reinado de su cruel hermana, la hechicera Morgan. Con tres dragones a su mando y el uso de magia oscura, persigue a los Caballeros de la Mesa Redonda hasta los confines de la Tierra. Galahad sabe que para sobrevivir, deberán encontrar a su padre, Lancelot, que lleva años en el exilio.

programme.title: Avalanche Sharks
programme.desc: Después de una terrible avalancha, el personal de Twin Pines Resort Sky comienza a recibir informes sobre personas que han desaparecido y criaturas que se mueven bajo la nieve.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Hermanos gemelos quedan atrapados en peligro después de que uno de ellos se ve envuelto en un conflicto de pandillas. Mientras uno busca la verdad detrás de la muerte de su hermano, el otro regresa con una nueva cara, ambos obligados a enfrentarse a las garras de las fuerzas del orden y del hampa.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo.

programme.title: Perfect weapon (Arma Perfecta)
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, una organización gubernamental y secreta dirigida por EL DIRECTOR controla todos los aspectos de la vida. Todos “los enemigos del estado” son castigados de manera severa y muchos de ellos son ejecutados mediante asesinos de la organización.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Rescate en Afganistán
programme.desc: Un comando de las operaciones especiales, liderado por el experto francotirador Jake Chandler, es enviado a un poblado de Afganistan para rescatar a un congresista capturado por los talibanes. La misión es un éxito, pero Jake, se queda en el campo de batalla para salvar a un soldado herido.

programme.title: Valentine, venganza oscura
programme.desc: La tranquila ciudad de Batavia ya no es lo que era. La violencia, los robos y la gran tasa de criminalidad hacen de sus calles un lugar inhabitable. En medio de ese caos vive Srimaya, una joven aspirante a actriz que, acabará convirtiéndose en una superheroína para acabar con el crimen de la ciudad.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Siete guerreros luchan contra Vlad “El Empalador” para salvar a su pueblo en una épica batalla final.

programme.title: Viking
programme.desc: Vladimir el Grande unifica tribus eslavas.

programme.title: Dragon Wars: D-War
programme.desc: La Tierra al borde de la destrucción tras el regreso de unos gigantescos dragones legendarios que ponen a la humanidad en peligro. El reportero Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) intentará investigar qué está pasando y cómo poder impedir la catástrofe...

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Andrew Neyman (Miles Teller) es un joven baterista de jazz, que solo tiene en mente estar a la altura para cumplir con las exigencias del elitista conservatorio de éxito al que asiste. Marcado por las vivencias de su fracasado padre, un escritor en ciernes, Andrew busca día y noche convertirse en uno de los grandes. Terence Fletcher (J.K. Simmons), instructor conocido por su talento para la enseñanza como por sus terribles métodos, lidera un grupo de jazz en la escuela superior. Fletcher descubre a Andrew y lo transfiere a su banda, hecho que marcará para siempre sus vidas.

programme.title: Anaconda 4: Rastro De Sangre
programme.desc: Una cría de anaconda, genéticamente mejorada, se ha regenerado y crece monstruosamente. La cría sedienta de sangre es aparentemente invencible, y se desliza entre explosiones y disparos para regenerarse y alimentarse insaciablemente de todo lo que se encuentre en su camino.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: La Amenaza

Pero cuando el hombre de negocios que financia todo, lleva el experimento demasiado lejos, las serpientes escapan, hambrientas y dirigiéndose hacia la civilización.
